description.en: OpenAI Platform API key. Stored in the system keychain and only passed to this plugin's tools. Not needed while the Codex subscription is allowed under Permissions below.
description.zh: OpenAI Platform 的 API Key。保存在系统钥匙串中，只交给本插件的工具。在下方“授权”中允许使用 Codex 订阅时不需要。

description.en: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API, ending before /images.
description.zh: 兼容 OpenAI 的接口地址，不含 /images 部分。

description.en: Optional. Sent as the OpenAI-Organization header.
description.zh: 选填。作为 OpenAI-Organization 请求头发送。

description.en: API key mode only. Flare is faster; Sunburst gives higher quality and steadier edits. On the Codex subscription the server picks the model.
description.zh: 仅 API Key 模式生效。Flare 更快，Sunburst 质量更高、编辑时更稳定。Codex 订阅模式由服务端决定模型。

description.en: API key mode only. auto, 1024x1024, 1536x1024, 1024x1536, or WIDTHxHEIGHT where the model supports it. On the Codex subscription the server picks the size.
description.zh: 仅 API Key 模式生效。auto、1024x1024、1536x1024、1024x1536，或模型支持时的 宽x高。Codex 订阅模式由服务端决定尺寸。

description.en: API key mode only. xhigh and max are documented for the gpt-image-2.5 models. On the Codex subscription the server picks the quality.
description.zh: 仅 API Key 模式生效。xhigh 和 max 只写明了 gpt-image-2.5 系列支持。Codex 订阅模式由服务端决定质量。

description.en: Transparent backgrounds need PNG or WebP output.
description.zh: 透明背景需要 PNG 或 WebP 格式。

description.en: API key mode only. The Codex subscription returns PNG.
description.zh: 仅 API Key 模式生效。Codex 订阅模式返回 PNG。

description.en: Where images and history.jsonl are saved. Relative paths start at the workspace root.
description.zh: 图片和 history.jsonl 的保存位置。相对路径从工作区根目录开始。

title.en: Show generated images to the model
title.zh: 把生成的图片回传给模型

description.en: When off, the model only receives the saved file paths.
description.zh: 关闭后模型只收到保存路径。

title.en: Show the status icon in the chat input
title.zh: 在输入栏显示状态图标

tools.name: image_generate
tools.description: Generate images from a text prompt with the OpenAI Images API and save them in the workspace. Returns the saved paths, the model's revised prompt and token usage. Use image_edit instead when reference images or a mask are involved. When the user runs it on their Codex subscription, only prompt, background and fileName take effect (the server picks model, size and quality and returns one image); the reply says which arguments were ignored.

prompt.description: What to draw. Be specific about subject, style, composition and any text to render.

size.description: auto, 1024x1024, 1536x1024 (landscape), 1024x1536 (portrait), or WIDTHxHEIGHT if the model supports it. Defaults to the plugin setting.

background.description: transparent needs png or webp. Defaults to the plugin setting.

fileName.description: Optional base file name without folder or extension.

model.description: Optional model override. Leave unset to use the plugin setting.

tools.name: image_edit
tools.description: Edit or combine existing images with the OpenAI Images API: pass workspace image paths as references (and optionally a PNG mask whose transparent area marks what to change) plus a prompt describing the result. Saves the results in the workspace and returns their paths. On the user's Codex subscription at most 5 references are accepted, masks are not, and only prompt, images, background and fileName take effect.

images.description: Reference image paths (png, jpeg or webp), relative to the workspace root or absolute.

mask.description: Optional PNG mask for the first image; fully transparent pixels mark the area to edit.

inputFidelity.description: How closely to keep details such as faces and logos from the references.

size.description: auto, 1024x1024, 1536x1024, 1024x1536, or WIDTHxHEIGHT if the model supports it.

fileName.description: Optional base file name without folder or extension.
